## A bullet slide is just a heading and a list

- Each `## Heading` starts a new slide at `slide-level: 2`
- Keep one idea per slide; write the title as a claim, not a label
- Put the narrative in speaker notes, not on the slide

::: {.notes}
Speaker notes live in a `::: {.notes}` block and never appear on the
slide. This deck is the toolkit's rendering smoke test — if it builds,
your environment can render presentations.
:::

## Figures come from executable Python chunks

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.2
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("assets").resolve()))
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import deck_mpl
from deck_mpl import BLUE, AMBER, GREEN, INK, MUTED, GROUND

deck_mpl.use()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 4.2))
ax.grid(False)

x = np.linspace(0, 10, 200)
ax.plot(x, np.sin(x) + 2.5, color=BLUE, label="series one")
ax.plot(x, np.cos(x) + 2.5, color=AMBER, label="series two")
ax.plot(x, 0.25 * x, color=GREEN, label="series three")

for c, y, name in [(BLUE, np.sin(10) + 2.5, "series one"),
                   (AMBER, np.cos(10) + 2.5, "series two"),
                   (GREEN, 2.5, "series three")]:
    ax.annotate(name, xy=(10, y), xytext=(9.9, y), ha="right",
                va="center", color=INK, fontsize=11)

ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("x", color=MUTED, loc="right")
ax.set_xlim(0, 11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

::: {.notes}
The chunk renders through `deck_mpl.use()`, which applies the palette and
emits a transparent PNG that composites on the slide ground. Swap the
palette in `assets/deck_mpl.py` for your brand.
:::

## Code blocks carry syntax highlighting

```bash
# rendered with the deck-code highlight theme
render() {
  quarto render deck.qmd --to pptx
}
```

- Fenced code blocks pick up `highlight-style` from the front matter
- Monospace font is set by `monofont`

::: {.notes}
The highlight theme is a Skylighting KDE-format JSON file. Colors here are
a generic terminal palette — edit `themes/deck-code.theme` to taste.
:::

## Tables render natively

| Element | Front-matter key | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Template | `reference-doc` | your `.pptx` with masters and layouts |
| Code colors | `highlight-style` | a `.theme` file |
| Mono font | `monofont` | e.g. Consolas |

::: {.notes}
Keep a table OR bullets on a slide, not both — pandoc splits a slide that
carries a table and a list into two slides. This slide keeps its list in
the notes for that reason.
:::
